what: Super-resolution (torchsr edsr_r16f64(2, True)) on a Snapdragon device DSP.

model.premise_kept: r16f64 is a REDUCED width, not the full EDSR. The op set is unaffected; a geometry-dependent verdict could be.
model.dtype: float32 in and out; the kernels are fp16 internally

device.note_skel: devloop/myskel and devloop/skel are byte-identical. The top-level execuTorch-ds/skel is a DIFFERENT build (1495192 B, md5 db74410ba0f9) and must not be used: the mismatch is rc=0 with no output.

gold_standards.device_scan_for_9fabbf1a: not found under execuTorch-ds; every *.bin was hashed

three_independent_lines: this one: the only geometry-gated portable node, gate hexagon_ops.py:415
the upsample line: the only portable node in the edsr upsampling path; its two view_copy went into the delegate as RASTER_BLIT and the permute stayed outside
.tmp/wt/diffusion unmerged commit e522ac1, 'unroll the outermost axis of a permutation instead of refusing it'
permute_convergence.why: the commit raises the ceiling from 3 advancing levels to 4 (after_ops.py:1053) and unrolls one level only when there are exactly 4 (after_ops.py:1055). The EDSR pixel_shuffle permute has 5.

measured.method: the gate function extracted verbatim from the commit, run on the EDSR shapes; the commit's own four claimed cases pass as controls first

what_would_reach_it.cost_estimate_not_measured: the moved tensor is 2,097,152 B; at 3 regions per command, 128 regions is about 43 commands against a delegate that currently carries 10

caveats: e522ac1 is based on a different tree (hexagon_ops.py 6285 lines there, 8600+ on the land tree) and is not a drop-in; it needs a rebase
only the gate function was measured, not a full export with the commit applied
